selectionPrinciple: Pre-declared municipality holdouts selected for structural diversity before their component-flow forecast results are inspected.

productionDecisionRule.municipalityRobustness: At most one holdout municipality may have component-flow n+1 net-migration MAE more than 10% worse than net_10y.
productionDecisionRule.note: Passing this gate is necessary but not sufficient for production promotion. No parameter or window may be retuned after viewing these holdout results and then re-evaluated on the same municipalities as independent evidence.

2480.name: Umeå
2480.rationale: Northern regional and university centre; tests a strong young-adult migration structure without using Luleå data.

2482.name: Skellefteå
2482.rationale: Northern industrial stress test with major structural change; tests robustness to non-stationary migration.

2380.name: Östersund
2380.rationale: Northern regional centre with a smaller population base than Luleå.

1780.name: Karlstad
1780.rationale: Regional university centre outside northern Sweden; tests geographic transferability.

0780.name: Växjö
0780.rationale: Regional university centre in southern Sweden; adds a structurally different external holdout.
